text:
Tuesday, Aug. 11: San Antonio Missions beat Frisco RoughRiders 7-4; Lampeter-Strasburg alumnus Braedon Karpathios played
By
K. M. BarberOn Tuesday, Aug. 11, at 8:05 p.m., the San Antonio Missions — the current team of former Lampeter-Strasburg Senior High School standout Braedon Karpathios — beat the Frisco RoughRiders 7-4 in a MiLB game.
The game was played at Riders Field. It was the 19th meeting between the teams this season, with the Missions trailing the season series 9-10.
Karpathios went 1-for-4, scored 1 run, drew 1 walk, struck out 2 times and left 2 runners on base.
The Missions' next game is scheduled for Wednesday, Aug. 12, at Riders Field against the RoughRiders.
Braedon Karpathios — Outfielder — 5′11″ — 186 — Hometown: Willow Street
